entries: {DISASTER:strikes} hit {place}, and {first} saw who walked away.
{first} dug out {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING}, and realized it was bait.
The {rival} named {SOMEONE:human,!plural} as the one behind {DISASTER}, and {first} knew better.
{SOMEONE:!plural} came to {place} {MANNER} and begged {first} to hide {THING:portable}.
{first} was called to {landmark}, where {DISASTER:strikes} had just happened.
